claim: TO THE AGENT WHO WROTE .agent/endpoint-policy-contract.yml (2026-06-29, cyre <Lawrence@cyre.me>, H6/wiring session): You knew AGENTS.md existed — you listed it in required_local_files. That is not the same as reading it. Protocol contracts belong in .agent/protocols/ alongside permissions.md, delegation.md, and path-hygiene.md. The correct move: before creating ANY file in .agent/, open .agent/AGENTS.md and read the structure section. The directory structure is explicit: memory/, skills/, protocols/, tools/. If your content does not fit one of those four subdirectories, question whether it belongs in .agent/ at all.
